info.title: Traigent Process Record Routes
info.description: Project-scoped preparation, retrieval, issuance and verification of process record certificates.

post.summary: Check receipt readiness for a process record
post.description: Reports the receipts currently visible for a build session. Send the build_session_ref as process_record_ref. The response echoes that reference. This probe does not reserve issuance. Until the build session is finalized, the reference does not yet resolve to an issuance and the call returns the declared 404 with code LINEAGE_UNMAPPED; finalize the build session first, then retry.

FrontClaimCompanion.description: Optional unsigned assessment delivered beside the signed certificate bundle. It is a closed projection of the retained assessment. Its absence is explicit when the assessment is served but was never retained.

outcome.description: Returned only for an outcome recorded at issuance whose references still resolve; an unresolvable historical configuration makes retrieve answer the declared closed 503 instead.

withheld_reason.description: Returned only for an outcome recorded at issuance whose references still resolve; an unresolvable historical configuration makes retrieve answer the declared closed 503 instead.

unresolved_ids.description: Always present. Normally empty: while historical configuration identities cannot be mapped, a historical configuration that cannot be resolved makes retrieve answer the declared closed 503 instead of listing it here.

headline.const: No enumerated comparable record in the declared scope dominates the selected configuration on every declared objective.
At least one enumerated record in the declared scope is at least as good on every declared objective and strictly better on one. The records are listed.
No record other than the selected configuration carried every declared objective, so no comparison was performed.
The selected configuration does not carry every declared objective, so it could not be placed against the other records.

outcome.description: Returned only for an outcome recorded at issuance whose references still resolve; an unresolvable historical configuration makes retrieve answer the declared closed 503 instead.

headline.const: The selection receipt named a configuration whose record no longer resolves, so no comparison was possible. Nothing is wrong with the objectives; the evidence for the selected configuration itself is gone.
No comparison was performed and none is claimed. The reason is recorded below.

unsigned_companion.const: This assessment companion is retained with this issuance. It is outside the signed V1 bundle and is not authenticated by the V1 signature or verified by the V1 standalone verifier.

digest_scope.const: This digest covers the candidate-ID list only; it does not authenticate the selected winner, scores, or original selection event.

bounded_claim.const: This records reported measurements and selection; any comparison applies only to the enumerated comparable records under the declared policy. It certifies no performance threshold or deployment fitness.

capture_basis.const: This is state observed at issuance, not a reconstruction of the state at the original selection, and it is a scope rather than an inventory. The selection receipt and the candidate records come from independent sources that can disagree, so a binding to the receipt is not a binding to the records this comparison used. No reconciliation between them is attempted or implied.

unsigned_companion.const: No unsigned assessment accompanies this issuance.

FrontClaimRecordReference.description: Public configuration run reference. Use the same reference for each occurrence of the same configuration in the companion.

FrontClaimExperimentRunReference.description: Reference to the experiment run associated with the build session.

FrontClaimObjectiveReference.description: A known metric label, or objective-<positive ordinal> for a custom objective.

reason.description: Not produced on these routes, because a finalized build session always carries its experiment run.

detail.const: No experiment run was named for this issuance, so no selection receipt or candidate records could be located.
The named experiment run does not resolve within the request's tenant and project scope.
No tenant and project scope was bound to the request, so no scoped read was performed.
No accepted, digest-checked selection receipt was usable for the named experiment run.
The declared objectives could not be used for a comparison. No objective was inferred or dropped.
A declared objective direction contradicts the metric semantics policy, so the comparison was withheld for the whole objective set.
The comparison inputs did not form a valid claim, so no assessment is claimed.
The assessment could not be computed, so no assessment is claimed.
The assessment exceeds the size limit and was withheld whole rather than trimmed.
No assessment was configured for this issuance, so none was attempted.
The retained assessment records a refusal without a listed public reason.
No assessment is retained for this issuance and none is reconstructed.

experiment_run_id_source.description: The run associated with the build session within the project supplies the reference, including when finalize omits experiment_run_id. Null indicates that the source is unavailable.

eligible_trial_ids_digest_scope.const: This digest covers the candidate-ID list only; it does not authenticate the selected winner, scores, or original selection event.

FrontClaimReportedValueText.description: Canonical decimal text represents the exact decimal value used in the comparison. Use the reported number's shortest round-trip decimal spelling, without a leading plus sign. Never round or change the value during normalization.

rule.description: Primary metrics win when present. Present means a non-empty primary metric mapping; when the primary mapping is empty, the secondary metrics are used.
